back: Software that records transactions, posts them to the ledgers automatically and produces reports.
Speed, accuracy of arithmetic, reports on demand, easy storage and retrieval, fewer staff for routine tasks.
Cost, training, dependence on power and equipment, hacking and viruses, system failure.
Different rights given to different users so that each can do only the tasks needed for their job.
A copy of data stored separately (ideally off-site) so it can be restored.
A record of who entered or changed each item, when, and the old and new values.
Passwords and access levels, backups, encryption, firewalls, anti-virus software, audit trails, physical security.
The system posts incorrect data accurately; validation checks reduce but do not remove keying errors.
To separate duties (entering, approving, changing master data) and reduce the risk of fraud.
